title: [ES] Extra Splashes
description: This pack adds 150 new splash texts. from references, to non-Minecrafty things!
body:
**A simple resource pack that only adds 161 new splash texts to Minecraft!**

# 🔩 Supports:

- 1.21.9-1.21.11
- Any mod
- Would NOT work if another pack that changes splash texts is ABOVE this pack on the pack list.
